[*][s]copy the cart.png of choice from pumpkin mod > assets > ext > monogram/initials A~Z alphabet folder and replace the cart.png in pumpkin mod > assets > ext[/s] [b]( [u]NEXT UPDATE[/u] )[/b]

[b][size=4][u]IF the "horse" reskin/replacement you're using doesn't match up with the drawbar[/u][/size][/b]:
[list=1]
[*][color=#f4cccc][u]turn on [b]Debug[/b][/u] in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14087]Personal Traveling Cart[/url] config,[/color]
[*][color=#b6d7a8]you can manually [u][b]adjust[/b] the [b]cart[/b] and player offsets [b]in-game[/b][/u] using the [u][b]arrow keys[/b] while riding in the cart[/u].[/color]
[*][color=#f4cccc]Hold down [u][b]shift[/b] to [b]move[/b] the [b]farmer[/b][/u], and hold down alt to move quicker.[/color]
[*][color=#b6d7a8]To get the coordinates for modified offsets, [u][b]press F5[/b] to [b]save[/b] to a JSON file[/u] in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14087]Personal Traveling Cart[/url] mod's assets folder.[/color] ([b]cart_data.json[/b])
[*][color=#f4cccc][u][b]Press F7[/b] to [b]reload[/b] data from that file[/u]. You can copy data from that file to the content pack to make the changes permanent.[/color]
[*][color=#b6d7a8][u]turn off [b]Debug[/b][/u] when you're done, to [u][b]prevent[/b] accidental cart/player [b]position movement[/b]/adjustment[/u].[/color]
[/list]
[list]
[*]or if you're not sure, you could request for it to be done; just let me know which mount you're trying to match up with.
[/list]
